svg.aria-label: Workflow 2: Quotes out the next day
svg.title: Workflow 2: Quotes out the next day
svg.text: The person who saw the job says what it needs; a draft is waiting before they’re back in the van.
Typed or dictated into the ServiceM8
Quote ready to check, notes and photos attached
Edits or approves in 2 minutes, from anywhere
Email: still want to go ahead?
Example: “CU change, 3-bed semi, Beeston. Old rewireable board, 9 circuits, no RCD. 1 day, 2 men. Needs bonding to gas.”
→ 6 lines from the price book: 10-way RCBO board, 9 RCBOs, SPD, main bonding, labour 16 h, EIC. Craig cut the labour to 14 h: £1,080 + VAT, sent at 07:40.
13-week results window: median enquiry → quote 0.9 days (was 4.2). Win rate 38% (was 32%).
Invent an item or a price
Draft can’t be made: Craig gets the note as
Every draft logged, with the note it came
Prices kept in ServiceM8 by Craig
